title: Invite shared
note: The phone made the invite: its id, a 32-byte token for the link, and the token's SHA-256, which is all the server receives (F11 D5, B-NFR-002). The link, which carries no name, goes to the share sheet and is never stored or shown again; the person sends it. When the share sheet closes the sheet closes too, and the tab says where the invite waits, with the pending row in place.
text: Asha · 7 months Who writes to Asha From Mama You Your co-parent Invited, open until Thu, Oct 22 Share again Cancel invite Tonight Book Family The invite waits on the Family tab until they join.
